_comment: FYRDrop egg for Pelican Panel (Wings v1.11+). Pelican imports Pterodactyl-format eggs natively — this file is identical in structure to eggs/pterodactyl/fyrdrop-egg.json with Pelican metadata.
name: FYRDrop
author: potenfyr-studios@users.noreply.github.com
description: Self-hosted sharing hub: files, text, image gallery, self-signed certificates, P2P transfer and federation. PIN-protected, AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest.

docker_images.ghcr.io/potenfyr-studios/fyrdrop:latest: FYRDrop official image (Bun runtime + app + built client).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /home/container/data/files /home/container/data/thumbs /home/container/data/certs /home/container/data/uploads_tmp
echo "FYRDrop data directories ready."
exit 0

variables.name: Max Upload (MB)
variables.description: Maximum size of a single uploaded file in megabytes.

variables.name: TLS Enabled
variables.description: auto = auto-generated self-signed HTTPS cert. 0 = plain HTTP (use a reverse proxy for TLS).

variables.name: TLS Common Name
variables.description: Common name for the auto-generated TLS certificate.

variables.name: Session TTL (days)
variables.description: How long a paired device stays signed in.
